Ravion deals damage to an enemy with multiple hits. Each hit also deals extra damage equal to a percentage of the enemy's lost HP.

Ravion launches 15 leaf cards to attack an enemy. Each card deals 40% + 6% ATK damage plus extra damage equal to 6% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 120% of Ravion's ATK per card. Ravion is unaffected while casting this skill.
每张飞牌造成的伤害提高至45% + 6% ATK。

为队友发放任务，任务完成后使该队友获得能量和攻击力加成；同时自己解锁技能“王牌绝杀”造成更高伤害并击倒目标敌人，同时降低目标敌人的攻击力和护甲。

Ravion assigns Objectives to his allies. When an ally completes their Objective, they recover Energy and gain an ATK boost. This also unlocks Ravion's Mortal Ace attack, which deals damage to an enemy, reduces their ATK and Phys DEF, and knocks them down.

战斗开始时，为最靠后的2名友军发放任务牌，当其累计对敌人造成沙利叶初始攻击力2000%的伤害或参与击败敌人后，任务完成（在挑战首领的模式中，改为固定在收到任务的第20秒完成任务）。 完成任务的角色立刻回复150能量并使自身获得沙利叶初始攻击力的12% + 1.5%，持续30秒。
 当总计完成2个任务后，沙利叶会解锁技能“王牌绝杀”：瞬移到场上累计输出最高的敌人身后，使其攻击力和护甲降低30%持续8秒，造成140% + 20% ATK伤害2次并击倒敌人，同时刷新技能“见好就收”的冷却时间；王牌绝杀释放过程期间霸体。

When a battle starts, Ravion assigns an Objective to each of the 2 rearmost allies. Allies complete their objective by either dealing damage equal to 2000% of Ravion's initial ATK or assisting or defeating an enemy. Upon completion, the ally recovers 150 Energy and increases their ATK by 12% + 1.5% of Ravion's initial ATK for 30s.
In boss fights, each Objective is set to be completed exactly 20 seconds after an ally receives it.
After 2 allies have completed their Objectives, Ravion activates Mortal Ace.
Mortal Ace: Ravion teleports behind the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, reduces their ATK and Phys DEF by 30% for 8s, then strikes them 2 times, each hit dealing 140% + 20% ATK damage and knocking them down. Using Mortal Ace also resets Phantom Gambit's cooldown, while Ravion remains unaffected during the Mortal Ace attack.
完成任务的角色获得沙利叶的初始攻击力比例提升至13% + 1.5%；“王牌绝杀”的造成的伤害提升至160% + 20% ATK。
Increases the ATK boost allies receive from completing the Objective to 13% + 1.5% of Ravion's initial ATK. Increases Mortal Ace's damage to 160% + 20% ATK.
完成任务的角色获得沙利叶的初始攻击力比例提升至14% + 1.5%；“王牌绝杀”的造成的伤害提升至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases the ATK boost allies receive from completing the Objective to 14% + 1.5% of Ravion's initial ATK. Increases Mortal Ace's damage to 180% + 20% ATK.
完成任务的角色获得沙利叶的初始攻击力比例提升至15% + 1.5%；“王牌绝杀”的造成的伤害提升至200% + 20% ATK。
Increases the ATK boost allies receive from completing the Objective to 15% + 1.5% of Ravion's initial ATK. Increases Mortal Ace's damage to 200% + 20% ATK.
连续在战场上瞬移三次，前两次对周围敌人造成伤害，第三次远离敌人。
Ravion teleports 3 times on the battlefield. The first 2 teleports deal damage to nearby enemies, and the third moves him to a spot away from enemies.
沙利叶在战场上连续瞬移共3次，前两次瞬移选择3格内敌人最密集的格子，对周围1格所有敌人造成120% + 15% ATK伤害；第三次瞬移优先选择范围内距离敌人最远的格子。沙利叶在本技能释放期间霸体。

Ravion teleports 3 times, each time targeting a tile within 3 tiles of his current position.
The first 2 teleports target the tile with the most enemies, dealing 120% + 15% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile upon arrival; the third teleport moves Ravion to a tile within range that is farthest from enemies.
Ravion is unaffected while casting this skill.

战斗中攻击力提升，“王牌绝杀”完成第一次攻击后攻击力进一步提升。
Ravion increases his ATK in battle. He further increases his ATK after his first Mortal Ace attack.
战斗中，自身攻击力提升9%，沙利叶第一次通过“王牌绝杀”完成攻击后额外提升6%攻击力。
Ravion increases his ATK by 9% in battle. He further increases his ATK by 6% after using his first Mortal Ace attack.

战斗中，自身攻击力提升15%，沙利叶第一次通过“王牌绝杀”完成攻击后额外提升10%攻击力。
Ravion increases his ATK by 15% in battle. He further increases his ATK by 10% after using his first Mortal Ace attack.
“王牌绝杀”完成攻击后给自己和任务完成的队友永久增加攻击力和急速。
After Ravion uses his first Mortal Ace attack, he permanently boosts ATK and Haste for himself and any allies who have completed their Objectives.
当沙利叶第一次通过“王牌绝杀”完成攻击后，所有完成任务的友军和沙利叶永久获得25急速和沙利叶25%初始攻击力的加成。
After Ravion uses his first Mortal Ace attack, he permanently increases Haste by 25 and ATK by 25% of his initial ATK for himself and any allies who have completed their Objectives.
任务完成后的永久攻击力的加成提升至30%。
Increases the permanent ATK boost after Ravion's first Mortal Ace attack to 30% of his initial ATK.

自身和接受作战任务的友方角色受到最后一击时，立即触发“紧急支援”：使其免于被击败，同时使双方获得200% ATK护盾和20点生命汲取，持续5秒。队友触发“紧急支援”时和沙利叶互换位置，沙利叶自身触发“紧急支援”时不会互换位置，而是刷新技能“见好就收”的冷却时间。每个角色最多触发1次“紧急支援”。
获得任务的友方角色通过本方法获得的护盾值会随着其任务完成进度等比例提升，最高为100%。

When Ravion or an ally with their Objective takes a fatal blow, Life Saver is triggered to prevent their defeat, granting a 200% ATK shield and 20 Life Drain for 5s.
If an ally triggers Life Saver, they swap positions with Ravion; if Ravion triggers Life Saver, no position swap occurs, but the cooldown of Phantom Gambit is reset.
Each unit can trigger Life Saver 1 time per battle.

Allies receive extra shield values based on how much progress they've made on their Objective. The closer to completion, the higher the extra shield value, up to 100%.
任务完成后的永久攻击力的加成提升至35%。
Increases the permanent ATK boost after Ravion's first Mortal Ace attack to 35% of his initial ATK.
队友在接受到任务时获得短暂的攻击力提升和霸体。
When an ally accepts Ravion's Objective, they temporarily increase their ATK and become unaffected for a short period.
队友在接受任务牌时获得15%攻击力提升和霸体，持续5秒。
When an ally accepts the Objective from Ravion, they increase their ATK by 15% and become unaffected. These effects last for 5s.
